summary: Brightstar Lottery PLC (formerly International Game Technology PLC) furnished a Form 6-K containing its unaudited condensed consolidated financial statements and MD&A for the period ended June 30, 2026. The filing is a routine periodic report by a foreign private issuer under Rule 13a-16, with no transactions, strategic initiatives, or corporate actions disclosed. Forward-looking statements reference general risks but announce no special situation. This is an ordinary financial reporting obligation, not a US-equivalent special event, merger, tender, or restructuring filing.
